Briar pipe.d: Italian pipe house founded in 1947 by Carlo Scotti in Cantù; grades include Collection, Old Antiquari and the carved Sea Rock.
London house founded in 1863 by Frederick Charatan; Herman G. Lane distributed it in the USA from 1955 and Dunhill bought it in 1978.
London house founded in 1812 by Benjamin Barling; the Family Era (1812-1962) is the period collectors prize.

brands.d: Cantù pipe maker founded by Carlo Scotti.
London maker founded by Frederick Charatan, owned by Dunhill from 1978.
London maker founded by Benjamin Barling, prized for its Family Era pipes.
